hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We have 8 available key slots (keys 2 through 9).

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: To minimize total presses, assign the first 8 characters to slot 1, the next 8 to slot 2, and so on.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Each letter i from 0 to len(word) - 1 requires (i // 8 + 1) key presses.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of input string word
complexity.notes: Direct mathematical summation of key press weights.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force keypad arrangement search is combinatorial.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that all characters are distinct in Part I.
